description: Emits an Event ID and payload to its active listeners and stores that payload for Get Data. Matching listeners handle the event before Emit continues. Listener failures are reported after the other listeners have been notified.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the Event ID and payload, then handle Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this custom event operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Exact custom event ID used by Emit, Listen, Clear, and Get Data. IDs are case sensitive and must not be blank.

inputs.name: data_payload
inputs.description: Event values as a map. Keys become text and null keys are skipped. Each matching listener receives the values, and Get Data returns the last emitted map.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after matching listeners have handled the emitted payload. A listener failure fails this operation after the other listeners are notified.

description: Waits for one named custom event. Positive Timeout Ticks limit the wait. Zero or negative values wait without a tick deadline. A match continues Flow once. Timeout, clear, or cancellation ends the wait without firing Flow.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the Event ID, then handle Flow and Listening.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this custom event operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Exact custom event ID used by Emit, Listen, Clear, and Get Data. IDs are case sensitive and must not be blank.

inputs.name: timeout_ticks
inputs.description: Maximum server ticks to wait for one event. Positive values set a deadline. Zero or negative values wait until an event arrives, listeners are cleared, or this flow is cancelled. Omitted values use 0.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues once when a matching event arrives. Registration, timeout, clear, and cancellation do not fire this output.

outputs.name: listening
outputs.description: True when event wait registration was accepted. Remains true after the wait ends. False when no event ID is supplied.

description: Keeps older flows that include an event definition step working. Continues immediately. Emit and Listen can use the Event ID directly.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the Event ID, then handle Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this custom event operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Event ID used by related Emit and Listen nodes. This legacy setup step continues immediately.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues immediately after the legacy event setup step.

description: Stops every listener for this Event ID and removes its last payload. Prevents future callbacks. A callback already running finishes before its listening flow stops.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the Event ID, then handle Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this custom event operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Exact custom event ID used by Emit, Listen, Clear, and Get Data. IDs are case sensitive and must not be blank.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after listeners are removed and the last payload is cleared. Event callbacks already running finish separately.

description: Reads the most recently emitted payload for this Event ID. Returns an empty map before the first emit or after listeners for the event are cleared.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the Event ID, then handle Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts this custom event operation when execution reaches the node.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Exact custom event ID used by Emit, Listen, Clear, and Get Data. IDs are case sensitive and must not be blank.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the last emitted payload has been read.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Last payload emitted for this Event ID as a map. Empty before the first emit or after listeners are cleared.
